title: Early Departure Charges Schedule, Guest Folios by Ashbury Brand
content:
The charge made on a Guest Folio when a guest checks out before the departure date on the reservation is set per brand: the basis of the charge (none, a flat fee, or one night of room and tax), the flat fee where that basis applies, and the rate plans that are never charged an early departure fee.

| Brand | Basis of the early departure charge | Flat fee | Rate plans never charged |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Express | None | $0.00 | Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate; Reward Night Rate |
| Ashbury Inn & Suites | None | $0.00 | Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate; Reward Night Rate |
| Ashbury Hotel | None | $0.00 | Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate; Reward Night Rate |
| Ashbury Grand | Flat fee | $75.00 | Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate; Reward Night Rate |
| Ashbury Resort & Spa | One night of room and tax | $0.00 | Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate; Reward Night Rate |
| Ashbury Reserve | One night of room and tax | $0.00 | Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate; Reward Night Rate |

## Notes

- **None** charges nothing. **Flat fee** charges the flat fee in the table. **One night of room and tax** charges one night at the reservation's nightly rate plus tax at its tax rate.
- The flat fee column is used only by the brand whose basis is a flat fee, Ashbury Grand; it reads $0.00 elsewhere.
- At every brand the same two rate plans are never charged: the Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate and the Reward Night Rate.

## Reading the schedule by case (hypothetical reservations)

| Hypothetical reservation | Charge the schedule gives |
|---|---|
| Ashbury Grand, Flexible Rate | $75.00 flat fee |
| Ashbury Grand, Reward Night Rate | Nothing; the rate plan is never charged |
| Ashbury Hotel, any rate plan | Nothing; the basis is none |
| Ashbury Reserve, Member Flexible Rate | One night of room and tax |
